planets.name: K2-210 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-210 with a 0.57-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-210 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-210. Its orbit and size follow Adams et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
